title: Ordinary-to-derived comparison for epimorphic fixed-scalar towers
statement: For a prime l and a scheme T with the stated derived localizations, every strict tower H of sheaves of modules over the fixed ring ULift Z_l whose consecutive transitions are epic has invertible canonical diagonalOrdinaryRlim comparison for any normalized DiagonalRlim L. The categories and comparison are those of det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit and def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models.

source.place: paragraph (1), Milnor comparison for quotient and root towers

proof.text: Use the equivalence between fixed-ring module sheaves and modules over the constant ring sheaf to transfer the epimorphic-tower Milnor difference-map assertion and exact countable products. For a complex whose degreewise towers are epimorphic, its ordinary inverse limit is the kernel of the Roos difference map, and the difference map is degreewise epic. Thus the zero-second-coordinate inclusion into the Roos fibre is a quasi-isomorphism. The normalized exact-products Roos comparison identifies its localization with the given derived unit L.eta. Applying this to a single tower in degree zero proves invertibility of diagonalOrdinaryRlim for either tower. The generic tower Grothendieck construction supplies the comparison theorem's size hypothesis.

proof_origin.place: Passage to the limit; normalized Roos-unit implementation of the coefficient comparison in trace paragraph (1).
